reason: I'd burn the 40 free documents on my old chat archive just to see if it flags the re-photographed transfers, but I could wire up n8n plus ChatGPT to dump receipts into a Sheet in an afternoon. Unless the duplicate catching is clearly better than what I'd build, I'm not paying monthly for a receipt-to-table bot.
objection: Will it actually catch the same bank-transfer screenshot sent twice by two different people, or a nota photographed again at a different angle? If it misses those, it's just OCR into a spreadsheet and I can do that myself.
would_change_my_mind: The free trial on my real chat history catching duplicates I had missed, with a few false alarms at most.
